study type: Case Series (analysis of prospective clinical studies data)
outcome: Hemostatic management efficacy (rated excellent or good)
cohort: Ten females with von Willebrand disease (VWD) of various types (1, 2, and 3) who received wilate for hemostatic coverage during childbirth.
finding: Wilate provided effective hemostatic cover for childbirth in females with VWD, preventing excessive bleeding during delivery and postpartum.
mod_finding: Hemostatic management with wilate was rated excellent or good for all 10 deliveries, which included 5 cesarean sections, with no excessive bleeding.
